name: tracker-retry-receipt
goal: Persist a successful native retry and its earlier retry credit atomically without modifying retained legacy receipts.

evidence: Live MB2 smoke run 6 failed and run 7 called tracker done. The scheduler then failed every tick while trying to write the earlier run without advancing its version.

The dispatcher credit test uses a fixture ledger without production receipt revision checks. The existing SQLite repository case now exercises failed worker exit, managed retry, and preserved legacy history.
Checkpoint 22e0d620d910 at 1064ef3557 failed with Tracker attempt version changed.
Retry credit uses the shared version increment and applies only to revisioned local receipts. The SQLite regression fixture is unchanged.
The unchanged SQLite regression passed at e13e7efaa1 in the same sanitized runtime as red. Runtime measurements are stored in the green checkpoint.
